sectors.name: Power Grid
sectors.description: High-voltage transmission systems affected by geomagnetically induced currents (GICs).

impact_levels.1: Nominal geomagnetic activity. No measurable GICs or voltage deviations.
impact_levels.2: Minor GICs at high latitudes. Operators monitor alerts.
impact_levels.3: Regional voltage regulation required. Possible equipment alarms.
impact_levels.4: Significant GICs; transformer heating or protection trips likely.
impact_levels.5: Widespread instability or blackouts. Emergency grid operations activated.

sectors.name: Aviation & HF Communications
sectors.description: Aircraft and communication systems using HF or GNSS affected by ionospheric disturbances and radiation.

impact_levels.2: Polar HF signal fading possible; flight ops monitor SWPC advisories.
impact_levels.3: Polar reroutes or altitude restrictions due to elevated radiation.
impact_levels.4: Widespread HF blackout; GNSS errors; operational delays.
impact_levels.5: Severe radiation hazard; trans-polar routes closed; crew/passenger dose management required.

sectors.name: Satellites / Spacecraft
sectors.description: Space-based assets subject to surface charging, drag, and single-event upsets.

impact_levels.2: Minor sensor anomalies or drag variations.
impact_levels.3: Increased upsets, orbit perturbations; safe-mode consideration.
impact_levels.4: Multiple anomalies; risk of attitude loss or data corruption.
impact_levels.5: Widespread spacecraft failures or total mission loss.

sectors.name: GPS / Navigation
sectors.description: GNSS signal degradation from ionospheric scintillation and storm-time TEC gradients.

impact_levels.1: Accurate positioning within nominal error budget.
impact_levels.2: Minor degradation at high latitudes or dusk sector.
impact_levels.3: Intermittent signal loss; increased differential errors.
impact_levels.4: Regional navigation outages; aviation and survey impact.
impact_levels.5: Global GNSS outage or unrecoverable error magnitudes.

sectors.name: Pipelines
sectors.description: Corrosion control systems influenced by geomagnetically induced voltages.

impact_levels.3: Elevated rectifier currents; temporary mitigation actions.
impact_levels.4: Significant corrosion potential; damage assessment required.
impact_levels.5: Widespread cathodic protection failure; system damage.

sectors.name: Human Spaceflight
sectors.description: Crewed missions exposed to radiation from solar energetic particles.

impact_levels.4: Critical dose thresholds approached; shelter procedures.
impact_levels.5: Severe exposure risk; mission-critical safety protocols enacted.

sectors.name: Public / Auroral Visibility
sectors.description: Societal and public interest impacts including aurora visibility and communications.

impact_levels.1: Aurora visible only at high latitudes.
impact_levels.2: Aurora visible mid-latitudes; minor HF disruptions.
impact_levels.3: Aurora visible to lower U.S. states; occasional HF loss.
impact_levels.4: Strong aurora globally; moderate radio disruptions.
impact_levels.5: Extreme visual and communication impacts worldwide.
